Acceptance document 3: a distinct local-only fixture sentence used to exercise repeatable data preparation. This file has unique terms 3 and deterministic content for tokenizer and shard validation.

Data engineering requires explicit schemas, stable identifiers, and reproducible transformations. A pipeline should record where every document originated, which processing stages changed it, and whether any records were excluded. Deterministic processing makes failures easier to reproduce and helps reviewers distinguish genuine source changes from accidental environmental differences. Validation should check both the contents of generated files and the relationships between their manifests.
